# dbtcloud_clickhouse_credential (Data Source)

ClickHouse credential data source



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (Number) Credential ID
- `project_id` (Number) Project ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource. Contains the project ID and the credential ID.
- `schema` (String) The schema where to create the dbt models
- `target_name` (String) Target name
- `threads` (Number) The number of threads to use for dbt operations
- `user` (String) The ClickHouse username
